form.official-title: To reauthorize the National Flood Insurance Program.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the NFIP Extension Act of 2021.

section.header: Reauthorization of national flood insurance program

subsection.text: Section 1309(a) of the National Flood Insurance Act of 1968 (42 U.S.C. 4016(a)) is amended by striking September 30, 2021 and inserting December 3, 2021.
Section 1319 of the National Flood Insurance Act of 1968 (42 U.S.C. 4026) is amended by striking September 30, 2021 and inserting December 3, 2021.

endorsement.action-desc: Read the second time and placed on the calendar
